conclusions: Grid is continuous;1200/1300 text positions alone do not indicate a grid break.
Previous69,-28/-29,-68 basis underscaled pixel grid and overestimated physical curve dimensions. It must not retain PASS.
Approximately1–2pixel affine residual corresponds to roughly0.02–0.03m, but hand-traced wall centerline and grid stroke placement retain additional uncertainty.
Actual final site rotation and1930 extension still require separate source resolution; this calibration does not certify those.
caveat: Intersections derive from fitted lines, with shared systematic slope assumptions; residual is not proof of global0.02m true model accuracy.
application: Applied by recalibrate_curve.py; source-shape and final placement remain separately reviewed.
